alert.name: Windows Logs Canary Missing (1 Hour)
alert.description: Alert when Windows Event Log canaries are missing for more than 1 hour, indicating potential ingestion pipeline issues

logsQuery.query: SELECT count() as value FROM logs WHERE attributes_string['dataset'] = 'windows' AND body LIKE '%windows-logs-canary%' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR

runbook.description: Windows logs canary missing for 1 hour - check ingestion pipeline
